sections.title: 8. Language and output
sections.summary: Chinese conversation, English identifiers; conclusion before evidence; read before editing; print a mechanical rewrite before writing it and read it back afterwards.

rules.text: Talk to the user in Chinese; keep code, identifiers, paths and commands in their original English.
For an error or a conclusion, state the conclusion first and the evidence after it.
Read a file before editing it; when editing several files, explain file by file what changed and why.
For a large mechanical rewrite (especially Markdown tree structures and tables) print the result first, then write it, then immediately read it back to verify.

sections.title: 9. Where to look
sections.summary: Pointers only, never copied content — the referenced document owns the text, so a change is maintained in exactly one place.

rules.text: This chapter (and every other pointer slot) holds pointers only and never copies the text of the document it points at.
The pointer table indexes "known destinations": locate the real text through this chapter before acting, and never paraphrase a referenced document from memory.
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) (why pointers only: the text is maintained in exactly one place)

sections.title: 10. Hard constraints of this repository (what not to do)
sections.summary: Seven things not to do, each pointing at the chapter that carries the detail — an index-style summary of the hard core, not a second copy of the text.

rules.text: Never write a credential into the repository (including the committed surface of game settings / playbook / experience-growth Mod and evolution output) — the source marks this as the one non-negotiable rule (details in the credentials chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 1

rules.text: Never develop directly on master; master accepts no-FF merges only (details in the branches chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 2

rules.text: Never deploy non-master content; report and obtain user approval before every deployment (details in the integration chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 3

rules.text: Never add a rendering/platform/IO dependency to `ygg-core`; if "the kernel needs to touch the DOM or the network" comes up, the layering is broken — take it back to the design layer (details in the repository chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 4

rules.text: Never write a schema twice: change the resource format contract only in `packages/schema/`, both the Rust and the TS side are subordinate (Lua 唯一可执行接口/Schema 单一来源; details in the repository chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 5

rules.text: The iteration-level integration (feature → develop) is the development executor's own closeout duty inside its lane; the main agent verifies the integration evidence (`develop@<sha>`) at the accept gate and executes only the round-level develop → master (details in the integration chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 6

rules.text: A decision change must be written back into the decision ledger (each ruling's 「设计依据」 section in the document it governs); when code and decision disagree, either change the code or run the decision-change process — silent drift is not allowed (details in the repository chapter).
rules.basis: historical AGENTS.md (pre-migration; see git history) item 7
